description: Changes to one existing form, as operations run in order. Each one is skipped when the form already has it, so the same spec can be sent again.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the form goes into.

form.description: The form's name, for example Information.

items.description: addField/moveField: column into section (after a column). removeField: column. addSection: section into tab. addTab: tab. setLabel/setVisible: on column, else section, else tab. addSubgrid: name, subgridTable into section. Tabs and sections match by name or label.

label.description: Label in the base language. For a new tab or section, its label.

after.description: Place it after this column (fields), section (addSection) or tab (addTab). Default: at the end.

subgridTable.description: addSubgrid: the table the subgrid lists.

relationship.description: addSubgrid: schema name of the relationship; without it the subgrid lists all records.

view.description: addSubgrid: name of a public view of subgridTable. Default: its default view.
